watch.summary: The creator is baffled and amused after hearing an esports team perform a pre-game chant that sounds like 'Ding Dong!'.

beats.what: Creator watches pre-match esports team footage.
Creator pauses, asking if the team just chanted 'Ding Dong'.
Creator cracks up imitating the chant as 'Ding Dong Chief!'.
The clip audio clearly plays the team shouting 'DING DONG!' together.
Creator bursts into laughter and asks his chat what their hype phrase actually is.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: What did they say, Ding Dong?
watch.why: The creator's genuine bewilderment at a pro esports team using 'Ding Dong' as their hype chant is infectious. His laughter and attempt to decipher the chant create an amusing, accessible lighthearted moment.
